pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, high-angularity dark regions with jagged edges and sharp pixel gradients. Patches exhibit complex polygonal shapes with significant variation in spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a dense topological mesh. Junction nodes are frequent with variable pixel thickness, narrowing significantly on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-contrast white focal anomaly is visible on the mid-dorsal flank area, disrupting the typical patch-corridor pattern.
